---
title: "Introduction"
---

This site provides setup guides and weekly lab materials for *Data Science Computing for Economics*, collected in one place.

Start with the Installation guide for your operating system, then follow the weekly pages in order.

## How this site is organized

| Section | What you will find |
|---|---|
| [Installation](installation/index.qmd) | Step-by-step setup of Python, Visual Studio Code, Jupyter, and Git, with separate guides for [macOS](installation/macos.qmd) and [Windows](installation/windows.qmd). |
| [Week 1](week1.qmd) | Tools of reproducible work: from your laptop to an automatically checked public repository. |
| More weeks | Added as the course progresses. |
